g.text: Jev 1.13.0: does its confidence know when humans disagree?
chaosnli — every item labelled by 100 annotators. A decision model's confidence should fall as human agreement falls. Here it does not: r = 0.046, and
the model is more confident than the human majority on 80% of items.
